body.name: binary Aronow--Samii zero-pairwise-inclusion correction
body.construction: In the Horvitz--Thompson sampling-total specialization with \(\pi_{\{i\}}>0\) and \(v_{z,i}=\mathbb 1\{i\in O_z\}/\pi_{\{i\}}\), define the simplified \(a_{ik}=b_{ik}=2\) correction of Section 3.2 of \cite{AronowSamii2013} by \(g_z^{\mathrm{AS}}(\theta|_{O_z}):=\sum_{i,k\in I:\pi_{\{i,k\}}>0}\mathbb 1\{\{i,k\}\subseteq O_z\}[(\pi_{\{i,k\}}-\pi_{\{i\}}\pi_{\{k\}})\theta_i\theta_k]/[\pi_{\{i,k\}}\pi_{\{i\}}\pi_{\{k\}}]+\sum_{i\ne k:\pi_{\{i,k\}}=0}\{\mathbb 1\{i\in O_z\}\theta_i/[2\pi_{\{i\}}]+\mathbb 1\{k\in O_z\}\theta_k/[2\pi_{\{k\}}]\}\), and set \(b_{\mathrm{AS}}(\theta):=\sum_zp_zg_z^{\mathrm{AS}}(\theta|_{O_z})\).
